summary: Allot Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a notice of its Annual General Meeting scheduled for October 22, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. Israel time, with a record date of September 9, 2026. Agenda items include declassifying the board via articles amendment, reelecting Class II directors David Reis and Raffi Kesten, approving officer/director compensation policy and director pay, and reappointing Kost Forer Gabbay Kasierer (EY) as auditor. No special-situation transaction, stake, or price terms are disclosed; a full proxy statement follows.
